title: Night Signal
tagline: A late-night transmission built for dark rooms and heavy systems.
description: A compact techno sketch with a pulsing low end and clipped analogue percussion. The lead arrives in short bursts, like a radio signal cutting in and out.

title: Chromatic Pressure
tagline: A tight sequence in constant motion.
description: A repeating metallic line moves across a dry four-on-the-floor rhythm, with a short breakdown that brings the bass back into focus.

title: Soft Circuit
tagline: Warm chords with a swung house groove.
description: A mellow bassline and open chords make room for a loose, syncopated drum pattern.

title: Below the Grid
tagline: Fast breaks over a sustained low end.
description: A quick, broken drum pattern and a deep bass tone. The middle section strips the groove down to a few clipped syncopations.

title: Glass Tides
tagline: Slow-moving tones on a wide stereo horizon.
description: Soft chord changes and a rising overtone give this piece a gradual sense of motion.

title: Blue Hour
tagline: A broken rhythm with a cool, spacious lead.
description: Sharp snares and a syncopated low end keep the track moving while a quieter melody repeats above the drums.

title: Pulse Theory
description: Sub bass, short synth taps, and a steady kick build a restrained groove.

title: Acid Bloom
tagline: Resonant bass with flashes of a brighter melody.
description: A springy bass part runs underneath bright, clipped tones and an open hi-hat pattern.

title: Distant Rooms
tagline: Soft textures with long, overlapping tails.
description: A small set of pads drift in and out of tune, with a quiet upper melody emerging near the end.
